_help._file: The three MODES an AI can be in (Muzzy, 2026-10-05): fight · flight · focus. A personality has a HOME mode (its own settings in personalities.json) and SWITCHES that put it heavily into one of these when a reading crosses a line — the Scholar is Focus until threatened, then Flight. While switched, the mode's goals, traits, sight and steady goals replace the personality's own.
_help.id: The mode's name (personalities' switches use it).
_help.goals: Goal priority in this mode — the goal roll walks this list.
_help.traits: Trait ranges in this mode (0–100). The main goal's trait decides how often it wins the roll.
_help.sight: How clearly it sees each kind of move in this mode (0–1). Flight is 'dumber' at seeing good casts; Focus is blind to traps.
_help.steady: Goals every move also tries for in this mode, 0–1.
_help.focus: How single-minded at a big moment (0–1).
